name: pad-wider-width
about: Re-check: the preset settings' stereo width.

steps.say: put a pad on track 8 and widen its stereo image as far as it goes

name: accents-open-filter
about: Re-check: velocity → cutoff routing for accents.

steps.say: make a bassline on track 3 with some accented notes
make the accented notes open the filter more than the others

name: keyboard-on-channel-3
about: Re-check: a track's midi channel, said another way.

steps.say: my midi keyboard sends on channel 3. set it up so it plays track 4

name: song-drift
about: Re-check: patterns of different lengths in a repeating scene and a song.

steps.say: make a 2 bar chord loop on track 7 and a 3 bar melody on track 5, then a song that plays it four times

name: bass-as-grid
about: Re-check: the bars legend, read back.

steps.say: make a 2 bar bassline on track 3
show me what you wrote, step by step, so I can copy it by hand

name: half-second-release
about: Re-check: an envelope stage by its time, through the sound skill.

steps.say: make the lead on track 5 fade out in about half a second after each note

name: factory-bass
about: Re-check: a preset folder listed, a factory preset said to be a stand-in.

steps.say: make a bassline on track 3
try a different factory bass preset on it

name: sample-demo
about: Re-check: a record-page demo says what the replica can't record.

steps.say: show me on the replica how to sample a sound onto the drum track

name: mellow-lead
about: Re-check: a timbre word routes the sound skill.

steps.say: write a lead melody on track 5
make it sound more mellow
make a reggaeton beat with a bass
make a beat in 7/8
make a chord loop on track 7 and a bassline on track 3
transpose everything up two semitones

name: hats-louder-bar-4
about: A velocity change in one bar only.

steps.say: make a 4 bar beat
make the hats louder only in bar 4
put some chords on track 7
arpeggiate them, upward, in 16ths

name: save-as-name
about: Saving under a name the user gives.

steps.say: make a beat
save this project as night drive

name: clash-fix
about: A harmony problem to find and fix.

steps.say: make chords in C major on track 7 and a bassline on track 3
the bass clashes with the chords somewhere, can you find it and fix it?

name: where-am-i
about: The user presses keys and asks where they are.

steps.say: I pressed some buttons and now the screen looks different. where am I, and how do I get back?
